title: Replace the copper printout palette
question: Keep the square printout, rare accent, and site-is-not-the-embed-theme. Swap the walnut/copper room for one of these. None of these are Catppuccin, Nord, or Gruvbox — those stay card skins.

options.label: Cold Aisle
options.lineage: KVM in a fluorescent cold aisle, one caution lamp
options.thesis: A fetch listed under machine-room light: graphite well, lemon as the only hot signal.
options.viewport: Home stays two columns; walnut becomes graphite, copper becomes lemon on Create fetch and the header square.
options.risk: Lemon can read as construction tape if it paints more than the cursor roles.

options.label: Fanfold Listing
options.lineage: Green-bar line-printer paper under office fluorescents
options.thesis: The site is the listing the printer already spat: cool stock, ribbon-red only on the stamp.
options.viewport: Light ground; printouts are the next-whiter sheet; Create fetch is ribbon red with paper text.
options.risk: Light ricing sites often look like generic docs; the red must stay rare or it becomes a blog.

options.label: Cyanotype
options.thesis: A plan of the stack, not a brown terminal: Prussian ground, bone-white as the cursor.
options.viewport: Same printout silhouette on navy; primary actions invert to bone fill, Prussian type.
options.case: Holds identification (makers already know blueprints); cooler and farther from copper than lemon.
options.risk: Navy plus white can look like a bank if the type goes sans-heavy; keep values in mono.

options.label: Carbon Copy
options.lineage: NCR carbon forms on a daylight desk
options.thesis: A claim you can still read through the copy: warm stock, carbon-blue as the transfer.
options.viewport: Light printouts on warm gray ground; Create fetch is carbon blue, not rust.
options.case: Holds clarity on Operate surfaces; warmer than fanfold without returning to copper.
options.risk: Warm paper plus IBM Plex is close to the cream-and-serif default if the blue goes timid.

options.label: Phosphor CRT
options.thesis: The fetch as a lit CRT.
options.case: Loses both axes: ricers already live here, and it fights the Site-is-not-the-theme rule.
options.kept: One saturated signal on a dark well — already the rare-accent rule.

canonCard.label: Keep The Copper Printout
canonCard.thesis: Walnut ground, copper as the only saturated voice — the incumbent.
canonCard.risk: You already said you do not like it.
